role: A map item's map data update: id plus the byte payload MapData.updateMPMapData applies.
scope_reason: world.conf maps = off: an empty map stays empty and a filled map from loot never draws, so the map layer that builds this packet never runs.

members.name: S34PacketMaps
members.note: the decoder's ctor only: Packet.generatePacket instantiates it by reflection (newInstance) for bytes read off a socket (MessageDeserializer); the integrated server's local channel passes packet objects with no codec (NetworkManager.provideLocalClient adds only the packet_handler), so it never runs

notes: The only sender is ItemMap.getUpdatePacketData (ItemMap.java:263), part of the map layer world.conf switches off; the oracle never builds the packet either.
